name: ansible-cve-2026-98432
description: Ansible role to audit Linux hosts for CVE-2026-98432 (critical IPv4 TCP use-after-free). Checks running kernel against known fixed versions, MPTCP status, and active MPTCP listeners across RHEL, Fedora, Debian, and Ubuntu. Produces clear per-host risk reports (high/medium/fixed). Read-only by default; ideal for fleet-wide inventory before patching.
